children.text: I'm a skilled developer with over a decade of experience, consistently delivering high-quality work across various government and private clients. I excel at breaking down complex problems and developing simple solutions, collaborating with colleagues from all disciplines to find the best approach possible.

My technical expertise spans the modern web stack — TypeScript, React, Vue, Next.js, Nuxt.js, Node.js, and Express — alongside a strong foundation in semantic accessible HTML and WCAG standards. I'm experienced with comprehensive testing practices using Cypress, Jest, and AVA, and have worked extensively with both custom applications and CMS platforms including WordPress and Drupal.

Since joining Nomensa/GAIN in 2020 as a Senior Frontend Developer, I've made significant contributions to projects for organizations like the NHS East of England Ambulance Service and Development Bank of Wales. I've been proactive in mentoring junior team members and sharing knowledge on relevant technologies with the wider team.

Throughout my career, I prioritise refactoring and reusing existing code patterns wherever possible to maintain compliance within established codebases and champion existing team practice. I foster strong relationships with all stakeholders and have progressed from junior developer roles to confidently leading technical decisions and supporting those around me.
